Proof in the paper: The TEM images and XRD spectra reveal that the synthesized NPs are all spherical-shaped and the (111) surface is the most stable for face-centered cubic (FCC) metals (Rh, Ir, Pt, Ag, Au, and Pd). The (111) surfaces were modeled by a supercell slab that consisted of a 3 × 3 surface unit cell with four single layers. The top two layers and the reactant molecules were fully relaxed until the maximum Hellmann–Feynman forces were <0.05 eV Å–1.
